user_query: I'm a journalist writing an article about the impact of social media on sports. Fetch the profile data of Neymar Jr. on Instagram, including his biography, followers count, and the number of accounts he follows. Retrieve the last 6 Instagram posts from Neymar Jr.'s feed and the details of each post. Also, find a success quote that I can include in my article.
